# **Attack on Titan Totem – Mikasa AckermanArmin**

Step into battle with the heart of **Armin** Arlert by your side!
This pack transforms your **Totem of Undying** into a pixel-art style **Armin totem**, bringing the spirit of humanity’s strategist into your Minecraft world. Designed in a faithful pixel-art aesthetic, it’s perfect for both casual play and anime-themed builds.

### Currently Available:

- **Eren** [Click Here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/totem-eren-attack-on-titan)
- **Mikasa** [Click Here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/totem-mikasa-attack-on-titan)
- **Armin** [Click Here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/totem-armin-attack-on-titan)

## ✨ Features:

- Custom pixel-art **Totem of Undying** as **Amin**
- Works seamlessly with vanilla textures
- Perfect for anime Minecraft setups or roleplay servers

## 🔧 Installation:

- Download the .zip file.
- Move it into your resourcepacks folder.
- Enable in-game.
- Rename Totem of Undying → Armin - Mikasa - Eren **(for CIT)**. (Soon Available)
